guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is 0, edn_req_hold_q is set to 0.
When rst_ni is 1, edn_req_hold_q updates to edn_req_hold_d at posedge clk_i.

assumptions.claim: edn_req_hold_d must meet setup/hold timing with respect to clk_i and must be free of glitches when rst_ni is deasserted.
assumptions.risk: If edn_req_hold_d is unstable, edn_req_hold_q may latch a glitch or X, potentially issuing a spurious or hung entropy request.

uncertain_points.claim: The register edn_req_hold_q latches edn_req_hold_d without any visible clear logic inside this chunk. The driving logic must ensure proper deassertion after acknowledgment; otherwise, a stale request may persist.
uncertain_points.risk: A stale or repeated EDN request could starve fresh entropy or leak request patterns, compromising cryptographic freshness.
